profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Georgia Tech CS | Turning complex technical problems into products that create measurable impact
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer at Microsoft building cloud infrastructure for Azure HPC/AI, where I work on large-scale distributed systems, deployment automation, developer tooling, and AI-powered workflows. My work spans improving infrastructure reliability and scalability, building CI/CD and observability solutions, and solving complex technical challenges that improve engineering productivity and support large-scale AI and HPC workloads.

Before Microsoft, I interned with Amazon Robotics AI, where I developed machine learning solutions that helped reduce operational costs by an estimated $50M annually and designed data annotation workflows that reduced annotation effort by 80%. These experiences reinforced my interest in using technology to solve complex, real-world problems at scale.

One of the experiences I'm most proud of was helping build PawPrint through Georgia Tech's CREATE-X startup program. Rather than focusing solely on the technology, our team worked to understand the needs of pet owners and veterinarians, translating those insights into a product that simplified health record management and collaboration. That experience showed me how much I enjoy bridging technical execution with product thinking and user needs.

My background is somewhat unconventional—I began my career as a civil engineer before transitioning into software engineering. Across both disciplines, the common thread has been my curiosity for understanding complex systems and making them better. Whether that system is a transportation network, a machine learning pipeline, or a hyperscale cloud platform, I'm passionate about learning unfamiliar domains, identifying opportunities for improvement, and working with others to build solutions that create meaningful impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and improve large-scale cluster management workflows supporting Azure's HPC/AI infrastructure, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
• Develop deployment automation and CI/CD workflows that streamline release processes, infrastructure validation, and cloud resource provisioning, reducing manual operational effort and improving engineering productivity.
• Build and maintain live Azure Data Explorer (ADX) dashboards using complex KQL queries to analyze workflow performance, SLA metrics, phase durations, and blocked-task diagnostics across multi-variant infrastructure validation workflows.
• Diagnose complex data integrity issues across shared workflow components and develop reusable KQL patterns to accurately attribute results to their originating workflows.
• Design and build an AI agent to automate hardware SKU onboarding into infrastructure validation workflows, analyzing compatibility across deployment mechanisms, cluster configurations, and VM sizing requirements.
• Partner across engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues, drive technical alignment, and contribute to infrastructure decisions balancing scalability, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · C# · Microsoft Azure · Kusto Query Language (KQL) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Azure Functions

positions.title: PawPrint Co-Founder / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-developed PawPrint, a pet health management platform through Georgia Tech's CREATE-X startup accelerator, designed to simplify medical record management and collaboration between pet owners and veterinary professionals.

• Helped design a product that addressed the fragmented experience of managing pet medical records by bringing health history, appointments, medications, vaccinations, and reminders into a single platform.
• Worked closely with teammates to define user workflows for both pet owners and veterinarians, balancing the needs of multiple user groups while prioritizing product functionality.
• Designed and implemented secure backend services and database architecture supporting role-based access, shared pet ownership, and collaborative record management.
• Built and deployed a full-stack web application using React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, taking the product from concept to a publicly accessible MVP.
• Collaborated in an agile startup environment, iterating on product features through continuous feedback, technical tradeoff discussions, and rapid development cycles.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · Node.js · Express.js · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Database Design · JSON Web Token (JWT) · Full-Stack Web Development · UI/UX Implementation · Domain & DNS Configuration · Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) · AWS EC2 · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Improved internal deployment workflows by designing automation that streamlined daily infrastructure validation and reduced manual operational effort.
• Developed tooling that gave engineers greater control over infrastructure validation during deployment, improving flexibility and debugging efficiency.
• Enhanced VM Scale Set management by simplifying configuration logic and improving the consistency of infrastructure compliance.
• Expanded functionality within an Azure infrastructure monitoring service, improving visibility into cloud resources and enabling more effective operational decision making.
positions.insights: Skills: Powershell · Microsoft Azure · Kusto Query Language (KQL) · Azure Data Lake · Performance Management · High Performance Computing (HPC)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern - Robotics AI
positions.description:
• Developed a machine learning-based text recognition service that helped reduce fulfillment center operational costs by an estimated $50M annually.
• Designed and implemented a data annotation pipeline that reduced annotation effort and processing time by approximately 80%, improving the quality and scalability of machine learning workflows.
• Evaluated more than 10,000 image samples across multiple OCR and segmentation models, using data-driven analysis to inform technical decisions and model selection.
• Authored technical design documents and research reports that aligned engineering stakeholders on system architecture, implementation strategy, and experimental findings.
• Collaborated with engineers to build scalable ML solutions that balanced technical feasibility with measurable business impact.
positions.insights: Skills: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) · NumPy · AWS Lambda · Python · cv2 · AWS SageMaker

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and presented a product prototype to stakeholders, helping secure a 20% increase in project funding through clear communication of customer value and technical feasibility.
• Collaborated on robotics initiatives by analyzing LiDAR data collected from autonomous systems operating in distribution centers.
• Improved scanning accuracy by identifying system limitations and implementing software enhancements that increased reliability.
• Developed automated tests contributing to approximately 99% service uptime and improving deployment confidence.

positions.title: Civil Engineer 2 - Roadway Design
positions.description:
• Led bridge replacement projects from planning through final delivery. 
• Presented designs to stakeholders and incorporated feedback from multiple organizations. 
• Balanced safety, regulatory compliance, timelines, and competing project constraints. 
• Developed strong project management and prioritization skills while coordinating multidisciplinary infrastructure projects.

positions.title: Technical Advisor
positions.description:
•Assisted in the configuration and setup of a Raspberry Pi for remote SSH access and proper firewall rules.
•Guided in the DDNS setup to access the web app from outside the local network, enabling remote access.
•Provided guidance on network security best practices for the project implementation.

positions.title: Cardano Blockchain Stake Pool Operator
positions.description:
•Managed three stake pool nodes on Google Cloud Platform with over $3.5M in combined staked assets.
•Applied DevOps skills to establish a safe and reliable connection from the relay nodes to the rest of the blockchain.
•Generated all sensitive files in an air-gapped offline machine and stored them in an encrypted device.
•Gained exposure to the Cardano CLI, Linux OS (Ubuntu) CLI, and git version control.

positions.title: Terrestrial Laser Scanning
positions.description:
•Distributed 6-in and 9-in scanning spheres around the scanning area.
•Handled 3D laser scanner and set it up to digitally capture the targeted environment.
•Verified the captured ”point clouds” are accurate and acceptable for use.

positions.title: Senior Project: Effect of Brine in OGFC Asphalt
positions.description:
•Project proposed by GDOT to evaluate the durability of Open Graded Friction Course asphalt.
•Made and tested multiple asphalt samples using the Cantabro, Fracture, DrainDown Tests, and freeze and thaw cycle.
•Used of additives (fibers, lime, silica fumes, fly ash) to slow down brine effects

positions.title: Project Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Performed quantity  takeoffs and pricing of purchase orders for projects in the bidding process.
•Along side the Superintendent, supervised field activities and safety procedures.
•Performed duties as assigned and within the established time-frame in a fast-paced, high pressure environment.

positions.title: Concrete Testing
positions.description:
•Performed compressive tests for the concrete cylinders at 7, 14, 21, and 28 days in accordance with ASTM Standard Specifications.
•Tested compressive strength of concrete cubes.
•Performed several concrete slump tests.

positions.title: Sieve Analysis, Proctor and Consolidation Tests
positions.description:
•Performed a particle size analysis using different sieves and a hydrometer in accordance to ASTM Standard Specifications.
•Performed the Standard Proctor test as well as the Modified Proctor test to obtain the specific density for an optimum water ratio.
•Performed a consolidation test with a duration of one week in order to determine the coefficient of consolidation by the Taylor and Casagrande methods.

positions.title: Masonry
positions.description:
•Performed the excavation and built the footings for the foundation that would support the walls.
•Built the steel elements to be used in the reinforced concrete columns and beams; including stirrups with their respective hooks.
•Created the mortar and concrete mix to be used on the brick and block walls.

positions.title: Electrical Installations in Buildings
positions.description:
•Calculated the required instantaneous power and current per circuit for any electrical device and outlet in a residential unit.
•Calculated the total amount of electrical cable footage, light bulbs, and other necessary materials to be used for the installation.
•Estimated the cost of each circuit and total cost of the project.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•Transferred phone calls to student veterans working in the office.
•Tracked working hours for assigned student veterans.
•Contributed with ideas for events and fundraisers to benefit the organization.

•Designed and built mechanism required to support a boomilever built by the participants.
•Designed the required structure for the Mystery Architecture Competition.
•Supervised and scored participants during both competitions according to given parameters.

organizations.name: Tau Beta Pi
organizations.description:
•Meet with the Committee prior the next school semester to review the budget.
•Plan fundraisers and various activities to be realized throughout the semester.
•Send notices of meetings to committee members and/or society members, as directed.

organizations.name: American Society of Civil Engineers
organizations.description: •Active member of the ASCE Georgia Southern University Chapter. Will participate in the Conference Concrete Canoe Competition 2019
